messages.subject: Indigo - drafting plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Let's get the licence first draft out by mid-November. Elena - you take the lead on drafting; use the exclusive field-of-use structure with the ADAS carve-out, the grant-back on improvements, and the minimum-royalty-converts-to-non-exclusive mechanism. Tom - please finish the IP ownership review and chase Hartington for the patent status report and the FTO on US10,114,202.

Keep the royalty at 6% in v1; we expect to land around 4.5%.

Kind regards,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
